hypothesis.statement: The residual is ONE mechanism at two sites and it lives inside a helper that ten call sites inline, EIGHT of them webfrank-pinned (DmgFxAdd, StartComboFX, SuicideExplosion, fn_80094164, StartBagFX, StartBlockFX, InitEffects, StartThrowMagicFX in config/GUNE5D/webfrank.json under `game/sfx/sfx`), so every source lever on it is a TU-wide edit wearing a one-function costume and must be arbitrated TU-wide, not on StartGemFX's `real`. The concrete untried idea: stop trying to move the ASSIGNMENT of `h` and change where `h` is CONSUMED. Today `h` is read only after the call (`MBTreeSetZsortAdd(page->fx[idx].node, h->zmod, 1)`), so MWCC has no reason to materialise its address before the guard load; the target materialises it first, which is what a build does when the address has a consumer the load does not dominate. Probe forms that give `h` an earlier consumer without adding an instruction -- reading `h->atree` THROUGH h in a way that survives displacement folding, or making the zsort/alpha pair read from a base established before the guard.
